title: Canonical normalized structural map on enlarged etale sites
statement: Let $S$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] and let $f:X\to Y$ be a morphism of algebraic spaces over $S$ [def-trf-algebraic-space]. Give each enlarged etale site its canonical ring sheaf $\widetilde{\mathcal O}_A$, the inverse image of $\mathcal O_A$ under scheme restriction, with the counit restriction isomorphism [lem-trf-space-enlarged-atlas-algebraic-extension]. There is a unique map $r:\widetilde{\mathcal O}_Y\to f_*\widetilde{\mathcal O}_X$, where $f_*$ evaluates on $X\times_YV$, such that for every pair of scheme etale objects $U/X,V/Y$ and every $S$-map $q:U\to V$ over $f$, its restriction to $U$, conjugated by the two counit normalizations, is the ordinary pullback $q^*:\Gamma(V,\mathcal O_V)\to\Gamma(U,\mathcal O_U)$.

proof.text: For each scheme object V over Y choose a surjective representable etale scheme atlas U of X times_Y V. By [lem-trf-space-enlarged-site-scheme-density] the chart is a singleton covering, and [lem-trf-space-enlarged-atlas-algebraic-extension] computes sections by the atlas equalizer. Pull a regular function on V back to U; its two pullbacks on the scheme overlap agree by functoriality. The equalizer uniquely glues the section; its injective map into the atlas sections verifies the ring operations.

For two atlases use their scheme fibre product over X times_Y V as common refinement. Covering base change and chartwise composition from [lem-trf-space-chartwise-etale-permanence] show that it covers both charts. Equalizer injectivity proves independence and the normalization on all scheme triangles. For V prime to V use the corresponding pullback refinement to prove naturality. Full faithfulness of ring restriction extends the resulting map on scheme objects uniquely to the enlarged ring sheaves. A normalized map must have these same restrictions by the equalizer injection, hence is unique. The canonical normalization is precisely enlargedStructureRestriction, so this gives IsEnlargedStructuralMap, without any choice of a new structure sheaf.

theorem enlargedStructuralMap_existsUnique {X Y : AlgebraicSpace S} (f : X ⟶ Y) :
    ∃! r : Y.enlargedStructureSheaf ⟶
        (enlargedDirectImage f RingCat.{u}).obj X.enlargedStructureSheaf,
      IsEnlargedStructuralMap f r
